purpose: Adversarial local tangent-space stress test; outcomes are conditional on the stated forward model and iid noise.

measurement.noise: iid Gaussian noise on real and imaginary samples; sigma is relative to measured-signal RMS
measurement.equal_budget_windows: center_3x3, low_3x3, high_3x3, and crosspeak_9 each use nine pixels; full uses nfreq squared pixels

interpretation: AIC win frequency is a local linearized diagnostic after tangent refitting, not a substitute for nonlinear likelihood fits. Large residual direction cosine means trap and dephasing remain hard to identify by microscopic identity even if both outperform A.
limitations: Finite-rate truth is first-order in kd; records report perturbation-to-signal ratio to expose breakdown of this approximation.
Noise covariance is iid and isotropic; real instrument correlations are not included.
No empirical experimental data are used.
